combined_substrate.basis: The fast-weight/delta state and episodic slot table are separate storage substrates. At this workload the episodic required load is 0/16 and the delta load is 6/8 under the measured operational envelope. This is a substrate-capacity conclusion only; it does not assert a trained router-level additive capacity.

delta_rule_interference.caution: The repository's declared threshold is on the mean recall cosine of a trial, not on every individual association. At n=6 the worst individual association across all 128 trials had cosine 0.8302, while the worst trial mean was 0.9397.
delta_rule_interference.metric_contract: per-trial mean recall cosine >= 0.90; safe capacity stops before first trial-level violation

episodic_bound.current_zpoly_evaluator_capacity_semanti: uncapped/oracle-position diagnostic; episodic_capacity is not explicitly set
episodic_bound.note: Capacity passes trivially for this curriculum because it imposes no mandatory long-range exact-fact load. For a finite-capacity real run, pin M=16 explicitly rather than leaving the diagnostic's None/unbounded setting implicit.

overall_gate.configuration_note: Explicitly pin finite episodic M=16 for the real run if the run is meant to be inside this measured finite envelope.

workload.curriculum: fixed G1-G3-derived matched curriculum used by the 16-seed position test
workload.episodic_requirement_basis: No task-specific exact record must survive outside the local window: the richest 47-token sequence places the first task-specific expression token 31 positions before the query, inside the 32-token local window. The fixed action ID header is constant across examples and externally restricts output classes, so it is not counted as a per-example exact episodic fact.
